note: Qualifying for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, Formula 1's return to Sepang after nine years, is today.

front.title: Apple Is Going to Further Tighten the Screws on Full Disk Access on macOS, in Response to Agentic AI Apps Running Amok
front.tldr: Apple will add new controls to macOS's Full Disk Access permission after AI agents began requesting broad access to files, mail and messages. The change responds to growing agentic AI use on Mac, with specifics still unannounced.

front.title: OpenAI's Dots: A First Look
front.tldr: OpenAI launched Dots, a personal agent inside the ChatGPT app, at its DevDay conference this week. MacStories' Federico Viticci set one up and named it Puck, previewing what day-to-day use looks like.

front.title: Behemoth! Review: Pedro Pascal Finally Finds His Perfect Movie Star Role in Tony Gilroy's Virtuoso Drama
front.tldr: Tony Gilroy's new film, which premiered at the New York Film Festival, gives Pedro Pascal his most complex role to date as a classical cellist. /Film calls it his best performance yet.

stories.title: Meta Wants Your Next Gadget to Be Muse-Infused
stories.tldr: Meta is giving away the code behind its Muse AI model so hobbyists and hardware makers can build it into their own gadgets, from TVs to toasters, extending Meta's AI reach beyond its own devices.

stories.title: Sean Parker Is Rebuilding Stability AI Around Music
stories.tldr: Sean Parker, the former Napster and Facebook executive, is relaunching Stability AI with a focus on music generation, this time with licensing support from record labels rather than their lawsuits.

stories.title: How I Used Notion, Agents, and Local AI to Research and Organize My iOS 27 Review
stories.tldr: Federico Viticci describes the Notion and local AI agent setup he built to research and write this year's iOS and iPadOS review, a rare detailed look at one writer's working AI toolkit.

stories.title: Laytr's New App Lets You Save Anything You Find Online, Not Just Articles to Read
stories.tldr: Laytr's new app lets people save articles, recipes, screenshots, videos and PDFs in one private, synced archive across Apple devices, aiming past read-it-later apps that only handle text.

stories.title: Rivian's R2 Just Helped It Set a New Sales Record
stories.tldr: Rivian delivered more than 19,000 EVs in the third quarter, up roughly 45 percent on the same period last year, with its new, cheaper R2 model driving the jump.

stories.title: YouTube Takes Aim at Clipper Accounts, Will Prioritize Original Shorts
stories.tldr: YouTube will start favouring original Shorts over accounts that simply re-clip other creators' longform videos, a change aimed at rewarding original work on the platform.

stories.title: Tesla Sustains Its EV Sales Momentum Despite US Troubles
stories.tldr: Tesla delivered more than 486,000 EVs in the third quarter, below last year's record but still trending upward despite a tougher US market for the company.

stories.title: Apple TV Releases 'The Sisters Grimm' Season 2 in Full
stories.tldr: Apple TV released all six new episodes of animated fantasy series 'The Sisters Grimm' season two at once, letting viewers binge the full run from today.

stories.title: Twelve South Launches Tiny New 'Airfly Drive' Wireless CarPlay Adapter
stories.tldr: Twelve South has launched Airfly Drive, a small wireless adapter that adds CarPlay to older cars, with 9to5Toys since publishing a full vehicle compatibility list.

stories.title: 'Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall' Review: PTA's Spellbinding Concert Doc Is a Gorgeously Tender Performance
stories.tldr: Paul Thomas Anderson operates his own camera for this New York Film Festival concert documentary of Geese frontman Cameron Winter playing sparse solo piano arrangements.

stories.title: J.A. Bayona Leads Field to Direct 'Jurassic World' Sequel
stories.tldr: Universal is understood to be eyeing Spanish director J.A. Bayona to return to the dinosaur franchise and helm the follow-up to Jurassic World Rebirth.

stories.title: Sony Pictures in Talks to Acquire Michael B. Jordan 'Battlefield' Video Game Movie
stories.tldr: Sony is in talks for a film adaptation of EA's Battlefield game, with Christopher McQuarrie set to write and direct and Michael B. Jordan producing and possibly starring.

stories.title: The New-Look Celtics Are Bonding, Thanks to Mike Conley
stories.tldr: Most of the 2026-27 Celtics roster has joined a fantasy football league together, with veteran Mike Conley credited for fostering the team bonding early in the season.

stories.title: How the Patriots Plan to Replace Christian Gonzalez Against the Bills
stories.tldr: Top cornerback Christian Gonzalez is out for Sunday's divisional game at Buffalo with a shoulder injury, forcing New England to rework its secondary against Josh Allen's Bills.

stories.title: Leclerc Quickest as Verstappen Avoids Softs and Hamilton Faces Investigation
stories.tldr: Charles Leclerc set the pace in second practice at Formula 1's return to Sepang, as Max Verstappen skipped a qualifying simulation and Lewis Hamilton was referred for impeding a rival.

stories.title: Craig Breslow Started Building the 2027 Red Sox in 2026
stories.tldr: After a Wild Card exit against the Yankees exposed scoring, bullpen and injury problems, Red Sox chief Craig Breslow is already working on fixes for 2027.

finally.title: Restorers Secretly Rebuilt a Workshop Inside the Panthéon to Repair Its Antique Clock
finally.tldr: In 2005, a team of restorers built a hidden workshop inside Paris's Panthéon and spent a year secretly repairing its antique clock, a quiet act of craft and devotion.
